question: Does AOS add enough practical value to justify further development, and is the repository clear and safe enough to invite community experimentation?
plain_summary: The first benchmark taught us what not to count as value. This holdout checks whether AOS finds a useful next action that GitHub did not already show and whether a new reader can understand the result.
claim_boundary: This is a read-only historical workflow study, not a live user trial. It can test exact-commit behavior, alignment with public human review, message clarity proxies and community-readiness mechanics. It cannot prove adoption, retention, willingness to pay, time saved, decision change in live use or defect prevention.

selection_rule: Use the most recently updated open, non-draft pull request among the first 20 candidates that is not bot-authored, has an exact head SHA, has at least one visible pull_request workflow run and has an explicit public human review outcome.

An eligible human outcome must state a problem, validation result, requested action or independently checked result. Bot-only comments, silent approvals, merge alone and author-only discussion do not qualify.
If no open pull request qualifies, use the most recently merged qualifying pull request since 2026-05-01.
Do not filter on AOS verdict, GitHub check conclusion, changed path or expected alignment with AOS.
sampling.outcome_enrichment_boundary: The holdout estimates alignment among review-rich pull requests. It does not estimate alert incidence across all pull requests.

cohorts.polish_definition: Repository maintained by an organization whose official material identifies a Polish registered office, headquarters or founding location. Individual nationality and comment language are not used.

comparators: GitHub state visible for the exact head SHA
A naive alert on every non-successful workflow
Independent public human review frozen before AOS
stopping_rule: Run all ten locked holdout cases. Do not stop after a favorable or unfavorable result. Fewer than eight completed cases yields INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.
publication_rule: Community release may be recommended only as a free experimental preview when mechanism integrity, plain-language and reproducible contribution gates pass. Historical alignment alone cannot justify a production or commercial claim.
